23:class Faker:
24:    """Proxy class capable of supporting multiple locales"""
25:
26:    cache_pattern: Pattern = re.compile(r"^_cached_\w*_mapping$")
27:    generator_attrs = [

32:        self,
33:        locale: str | Sequence[str] | dict[str, int | float] | None = None,
34:        providers: list[str] | None = None,
35:        generator: Generator | None = None,
36:        includes: list[str] | None = None,
37:        use_weighting: bool = True,
38:        **config: Any,
39:    ) -> None:
40:        self._factory_map: OrderedDict[str, Generator | Faker] = OrderedDict()
41:        self._weights = None
42:        self._unique_proxy = UniqueProxy(self)
43:        self._optional_proxy = OptionalProxy(self)
44:
45:        if isinstance(locale, str):
46:            locales = [locale.replace("-", "_")]
47:
48:        # This guarantees a FIFO ordering of elements in `locales` based on the final
49:        # locale string while discarding duplicates after processing
50:        elif isinstance(locale, (list, tuple, set)):
51:            locales = []
52:            for code in locale:
53:                if not isinstance(code, str):
54:                    raise TypeError(f'The locale "{str(code)}" must be a string.')
55:                final_locale = code.replace("-", "_")
56:                if final_locale not in locales:
57:                    locales.append(final_locale)
58:
59:        elif isinstance(locale, (OrderedDict, dict)):
60:            assert all(isinstance(v, (int, float)) for v in locale.values())
61:            odict = OrderedDict()
62:            for k, v in locale.items():
63:                key = k.replace("-", "_")
64:                odict[key] = v
65:            locales = list(odict.keys())
66:            self._weights = list(odict.values())
67:
68:        else:
69:            locales = [DEFAULT_LOCALE]
70:
71:        if len(locales) == 1:
72:            self._factory_map[locales[0]] = Factory.create(
73:                locales[0],
74:                providers,
75:                generator,
76:                includes,
77:                use_weighting=use_weighting,
78:                **config,
79:            )
80:        else:
81:            for locale in locales:
82:                self._factory_map[locale] = Faker(
83:                    locale,
84:                    providers,
85:                    generator,
86:                    includes,
87:                    use_weighting=use_weighting,
88:                    **config,
89:                )

91:        self._locales = locales
92:        self._factories = list(self._factory_map.values())
93:
94:    def __dir__(self):
95:        attributes = set(super().__dir__())
96:        for factory in self.factories:
97:            attributes |= {attr for attr in dir(factory) if not attr.startswith("_")}
98:        return sorted(attributes)

100:    def __getitem__(self, locale: str) -> Faker:
101:        if locale.replace("-", "_") in self.locales and len(self.locales) == 1:
102:            return self
103:        instance = self._factory_map[locale.replace("-", "_")]
104:        assert isinstance(instance, Faker)  # for mypy
105:        return instance
106:
107:    def __getattribute__(self, attr: str) -> Any:
108:        """
109:        Handles the "attribute resolution" behavior for declared members of this proxy class
110:
111:        The class method `seed` cannot be called from an instance.
112:
113:        :param attr: attribute name
114:        :return: the appropriate attribute
115:        """
116:        if attr == "seed":
117:            msg = "Calling `.seed()` on instances is deprecated. Use the class method `Faker.seed()` instead."
118:            raise TypeError(msg)
119:        else:
120:            return super().__getattribute__(attr)
121:
122:    def __getattr__(self, attr: str) -> Any:
123:        """
124:        Handles cache access and proxying behavior
125:
126:        :param attr: attribute name
127:        :return: the appropriate attribute
128:        """
129:        if len(self._factories) == 1:
130:            return getattr(self._factories[0], attr)
131:        elif attr in self.generator_attrs:
132:            msg = "Proxying calls to `%s` is not implemented in multiple locale mode." % attr
133:            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
134:        elif self.cache_pattern.match(attr):
135:            msg = "Cached attribute `%s` does not exist" % attr
136:            raise AttributeError(msg)
137:        else:
138:            factory = self._select_factory(attr)
139:            return getattr(factory, attr)

141:    def __deepcopy__(self, memodict):
142:        cls = self.__class__
143:        result = cls.__new__(cls)
144:        result._locales = copy.deepcopy(self._locales)
145:        result._factories = copy.deepcopy(self._factories)
146:        result._factory_map = copy.deepcopy(self._factory_map)
147:        result._weights = copy.deepcopy(self._weights)
148:        result._unique_proxy = UniqueProxy(self)
149:        result._unique_proxy._seen = {k: {result._unique_proxy._sentinel} for k in self._unique_proxy._seen.keys()}
150:        return result

152:    def __setstate__(self, state: Any) -> None:
153:        self.__dict__.update(state)
154:
155:    @property
156:    def unique(self) -> UniqueProxy:
157:        return self._unique_proxy
158:
159:    @property
160:    def optional(self) -> OptionalProxy:
161:        return self._optional_proxy

163:    def _select_factory(self, method_name: str) -> Factory:
164:        """
165:        Returns a random factory that supports the provider method
166:
167:        :param method_name: Name of provider method
168:        :return: A factory that supports the provider method
169:        """
170:
171:        factories, weights = self._map_provider_method(method_name)
172:
173:        if len(factories) == 0:
174:            msg = f"No generator object has attribute {method_name!r}"
175:            raise AttributeError(msg)
176:        elif len(factories) == 1:
177:            return factories[0]
178:
179:        if weights:
180:            factory = self._select_factory_distribution(factories, weights)
181:        else:
182:            factory = self._select_factory_choice(factories)
183:        return factory
184:
185:    def _select_factory_distribution(self, factories, weights):
186:        return choices_distribution(factories, weights, random, length=1)[0]
187:
188:    def _select_factory_choice(self, factories):
189:        return random.choice(factories)

192:        """
193:        Creates a 2-tuple of factories and weights for the given provider method name
194:
195:        The first element of the tuple contains a list of compatible factories.
196:        The second element of the tuple contains a list of distribution weights.
